proposals.issue_title: Monolithic Image Generation Duplication across 20+ Pipelines
proposals.current_pain_description: Each pipeline implements its own image generation requests, HTTP headers, and error handling. Switching from Pollinations to Runware or Together AI requires updating dozens of files manually, which is impossible to manage from Termux.
proposals.proposed_fix: Extract all image generation logic into a unified utility module `libs/image_generator.py`. Implement a centralized fallback chain (Runware PAYG -> Together AI -> Cloudflare -> Pollinations) with standardized input/output schemas.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: High code maintainability; instant switch of image providers system-wide in 1 minute; zero-code updates for future pipelines.

proposals.issue_title: Silent Runware Budget Exhaustion Risk in GitHub Actions
proposals.current_pain_description: GitHub Actions runs on automated triggers. A bug or infinite loop in a workflow could exhaust Hugo's entire 20 EUR monthly budget on Runware within hours.
proposals.proposed_fix: Add a centralized budget-guard mechanism in the API caller. Fetch and write daily usage to a state file (`.github/runware_quota.json`) using GitHub Repository Variables. Block execution if daily usage exceeds 0.66 EUR (~110 images).
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Elimination of unexpected financial loss; ensures the 20 EUR budget lasts exactly 30 days.

proposals.issue_title: Friction in Manual Upload from Android (Termux) to Platforms
proposals.current_pain_description: Hugo has no PC. Downloading raw images, scaling them, writing titles/tags, and uploading them to KDP or Redbubble from a phone is extremely slow and tedious.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a `package_delivery` script in GHA. For every successful run, package the assets into a single ZIP, generate optimized platform-specific metadata in a clean `COPY_PASTE.txt` file (Title, Description, Tags), and host the ZIP temporarily on a free transfer service (e.g., transfer.sh) with a QR code generated in the GHA log for easy phone downloading.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Reduces manual publishing time per product from 20 minutes to under 3 minutes on Android.

proposals.issue_title: Lack of Automated Visual Quality Control for Generated Assets
proposals.current_pain_description: AI-generated coloring books and assets often have broken anatomy, blurry lines, or solid black blobs. Hugo wasting limited time reviewing garbage images on his phone is highly inefficient.
proposals.proposed_fix: Integrate a lightweight, cost-effective vision check using Gemini 2.5 Flash (which is highly capable and extremely cheap/free tier) to audit generated images. Reject any image that fails prompt alignment, has visible AI artifacting, or lacks clean black-and-white vector-like lines for coloring books.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Filter out up to 90% of deformed/low-quality images before they ever reach Hugo's phone, preserving his 10h/week for high-value tasks.

proposals.issue_title: Missed Cross-Pollination of Single Designs into Multi-Format Products
proposals.current_pain_description: A vector design produced for a coloring book is only used for KDP. The exact same asset could be sold as a digital SVG pack on Etsy, a transparent PNG on Redbubble, or a laser-cutting file.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement a 'Format Router' post-processor. When a high-quality line-art or SVG asset is generated, automatically run parallel scaling/conversion steps to output: 1) High-res 300DPI transparent PNG for Redbubble, 2) Clean vector SVG for Etsy, 3) Compiled PDF page for KDP.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Multiplies inventory listings by 3x with zero additional image generation API costs.

proposals.issue_title: Brittle HTTP Error Handling and Rate Limit Crashes on GitHub Actions
proposals.current_pain_description: GitHub Actions runners share common IP ranges, frequently causing third-party APIs (like Pollinations, Together AI, or Hugging Face) to return 429 (Too Many Requests) or 403 (Forbidden). Standard request libraries fail immediately without retries.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement an exponential backoff decorator with jitter in all API-calling scripts. Use a rotating User-Agent header and, if 403/429 persists, automatically failover to a secondary API endpoint immediately rather than crashing the GHA workflow run.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Prevents 80% of silent workflow failures, ensuring consistent nightly generation runs.
